metadata.author: SOCRadar

metadata.description: NOT RECOMMENDED: deploy azuredeploy.json from the repository root instead. --- Microsoft Sentinel Log Analytics Workspace Name

Region of the Log Analytics workspace (e.g., centralus, northeurope). This is the region of the WORKSPACE, which can differ from the region of the resource group you deploy into; read it from the workspace Overview blade rather than assuming. A wrong value fails the deployment with LinkedResourceNotFound: Linked Workspace ... was not found in location <region>; if the workspace name is correct, that error means this parameter is wrong.
